source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of co-dominance, block for block (PDF 91-92).

blocks.text: Co-dominance virasat ki woh qisam hai jis mein heterozygous fard mein gene jore ke dono alleles poori tarah zahir hote hain. Is mein dono alleles na aapas mein milte (blend) hain aur na aik doosre ko chhupata hai. Is liye heterozygote ke phenotype mein dono alleles ki paidawar (products) aik saath nazar aati hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: 'L' Landsteiner aur Levine ke naam se hai, jin sciencedanon ne 1927 mein yeh system daryaft kiya.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Ise MNS system bhi kehte hain, kyunke MN group aur S/s group ke genes aik hi chromosome par juray hue (linked) hain.
Insanon ka MN blood group co-dominance dikhata hai, jis mein dono alleles barabar zahir hote hain. Is system ke do alleles hain:

items: Allele Lᴹ: M antigen banata hai.
Allele Lᴺ: N antigen banata hai.

blocks.text: Lᴹ aur Lᴺ dono codominant hain. Is liye agar dono maujood hon to red blood cells par dono antigens aate hain. Is tarah teen soorten banti hain:

items: M blood group (LᴹLᴹ): sirf M antigens wale log.
N blood group (LᴺLᴺ): sirf N antigens wale log.
MN blood group (LᴹLᴺ): M aur N dono antigens wale log.

blocks.caption: Incomplete dominance aur co-dominance ka muqabla
rows: 1. Heterozygote mein dono genes apne asar mila dete (blend karte) hain.
1. Heterozygote mein dono genes apna apna asar poori tarah dikhate hain.
2. Heterozygote dono walidain ke beech ka (intermediate) phenotype dikhata hai.
2. Heterozygote aik hi waqt mein dono walidain ke phenotypes dikhata hai.
3. Misaal: Japani 4 o’clock paude mein phool ka rang.
3. Misaal: insanon ka MN blood group aur AB blood group.

blocks.prompt: Mard LᴹLᴺ hai aur biwi LᴺLᴺ. Bachchon ke kaun se blood groups aur kis ratio mein ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Baap Lᴹ ya Lᴺ deta hai, maa sirf Lᴺ. Bachche LᴹLᴺ (MN group) ya LᴺLᴺ (N group) honge, 1 : 1 ratio mein.

items: Co-dominance: heterozygote mein dono alleles poore zahir (LᴹLᴺ par M aur N dono antigens).
Incomplete dominance mein asar milta hai; co-dominance mein dono alag alag nazar aate hain.
